idea-plugin.name: SVG Toolkit
idea-plugin.description:
SVG Toolkit - Inspect, edit, preview, and export SVG graphics in IntelliJ IDEA.

Core Features

  • Smart SVG Detection - Finds data:image/svg+xml;base64,... strings in code (handles line breaks, charset, multiple encodings)
  • Gutter Icon Preview - Shows 16×16px preview icon in editor margin
  • Standalone SVG Files - Right-click an .svg file in the Project view and choose Open with SVG Toolkit
  • Editable Source and Live Preview - Edit formatted SVG source and see the preview update without changing the original until you choose Save
  • Flexible Layout - View the source and preview side by side, or switch to source-only or preview-only
  • Preview Controls - Zoom, fit, 1:1 view, checkerboard and grid toggles
  • File Menu - Save edits to an opened standalone SVG, save as SVG or PNG, or copy the preview as PNG or the SVG as a complete Base64 data URI
  • Broad URI Support - Decode standard and URL-safe Base64, URL-encoded, and plain SVG data URIs
  • User Settings - Configure MAX_INLINE_SIZE (default 200 KB)
